stories.headline: US blames a botched equipment upgrade for nationwide flight halt
body: The US transport secretary says a router upgrade at a remote site caused Friday's nationwide FAA ground stop.
He blamed contractor error or faulty equipment.
stories.joke: One router, thousands of grounded flights.
stories.vc: Air traffic failures cost airlines heavily and add pressure for modernisation.

stories.headline: Kushner says he aims to broker Europe–Russia talks on Ukraine
body: US envoy Jared Kushner says he is working to bring Europe into direct talks with Russia.
He says both sides know compromises are needed.
Last week's talks in Abu Dhabi ended with a prisoner swap but no breakthrough.
stories.vc: Europe's direct role could shape who pays for Ukraine's recovery.

stories.headline: India's apparel exports jump 20% on a weaker rupee
body: Apparel exports rose 20.33% in dollar terms in October.
A weaker rupee drove most of the gain, while volumes rose less.
Exporters say orders are strong across markets.
stories.joke: The weak rupee finally did someone a favour.
stories.vc: Strong orders help garment hubs like Tiruppur and Coimbatore.

stories.headline: Tata Motors' passenger vehicle arm posts ₹5,531 crore loss
body: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles posted a ₹5,531 crore loss for the quarter.
A one-time charge and JLR restructuring hit results.
stories.vc: JLR's restructuring remains the key swing factor for Tata Motors' value.

stories.headline: Anup Gupta to leave Nexus Venture Partners after 16 years
body: Anup Gupta is stepping down as a partner at Nexus Venture Partners.
He's the second Nexus partner to leave this year.
stories.vc: Partner changes at top VC firms can shift which startups they back.

stories.headline: Asian governments react to Jensen Huang's exit
body: Some Asian governments moved to confirm chip supply deals after Huang's departure.
Others are watching the impact on local projects.
Nvidia has close ties with many Asian partners.
stories.vc: Asian chip and AI projects depend heavily on Nvidia's stability.
